admission.capacityNote: 100 study places in 2026; 595 applicants, of whom 417 applied in quota 2.

selection.description: A motivational cover letter is recommended for quota 2 applicants.

requirements.label: Mathematics at A level, minimum grade 6
requirements.subject: Mathematics

requirements.label: English at B level, minimum grade 6
requirements.subject: English

officialRequirementsText.text: A qualifying examination certificate equal to a Danish upper secondary school leaving certificate. Mathematics corresponding to the Danish A-level with an average mark of at least 6. English corresponding to the Danish B-level with an average mark of at least 6 (no grade requirement if you have passed English at Danish A-level).

notes: Non-EU tuition at institution level: EUR 8,250 per semester, EUR 49,500 for the full three-year programme (2026 admission). Application fee EUR 150. No scholarships are available at bachelor's level.
